BREAKING: NASA has launched a new website for its Moon Base missions 🌕🚀

The plan outlines a long-term vision to build a permanent lunar outpost near the Moon’s South Pole, with an estimated $20 billion development roadmap.

NASA describes the Moon Base as a “home away from Earth” for Artemis astronauts — a place where humans will live and work as part of the first sustained presence on another world.

The program brings together international space agencies, industry partners and academia to build and operate the lunar outpost.

@SpaceX’s Starship will play a key role in enabling these missions, providing heavy-lift capability for large-scale lunar infrastructure.

“This is the first step toward an enduring human presence beyond Earth.”

Tesla and Volvo Cars are making EV charging across Europe significantly more convenient.

Starting in Q4 2026, Volvo EV owners will gain seamless access to more than 20,000 Tesla Superchargers across 29 European countries through an expanded partnership between the two companies.

The integration will be fully native inside the Volvo Cars app, meaning drivers won’t need the Tesla app or separate accounts. Owners will be able to locate Superchargers, check stall availability, start charging sessions, and complete payments directly through Volvo’s ecosystem.

The move marks another major step in Tesla’s broader effort to open the Supercharger network to more non-Tesla EVs and improve charging accessibility worldwide.

According to Musk, the company manufacturing the suicide drones incorrectly used the civilian Starlink system instead of Starshield.
